A vocal group of Gamers, who had long suspected that the Gaming Press were crooked, jumped all over this and began demanding answers. I'll give you a potted history from the start:

  • All starts when the ex BF of a game developer writes a blog post accusing his ex (Zoe Quinn, an indie "game developer") of serial infidelity. He did not name the people his ex slept with.

  • Internet sleuths figure out who they are and lo and behold many of them happen to be video games journalists who have provided very favorable coverage to Zoe Quinns game called Depression Quest despite it being a piece of shit Twine game that is wholly without merit.

  • A youtuber named InternetAristocrat makes a video calling out everyone involved. The video is posted to reddit where it blows up. Zoe Quinn is friendly with some mods there and leverages this connection to get all mentions of the blog post and the video scrubbed resulting in massive comment graveyards and mass shodowbanning.

  • Streisand Effect takes full effect, people start to take notice and people are rightly pissed off over the collusion and censorship.

  • The games press decide that the smart way to handle this is to insult their audience and tell them to stfu. Strangely similar articles are published across a variety of gaming websites, some on the very same day declaring "Gamers are Dead, Gamers Don't Have to be Your Audience". The similarities of the articles set peoples bullshit detectors off and all these websites are accused of mass collusion. The GamerGate moniker is coined at this point.

  • Wouldn't you know it a leak shows that all the websites who published such articles are in fact communicating and colluding behind the scenes in a secret mailing list called GamesJournoPros. Leaks show how they tried to frame the narrative and mitigate blow back.

  • People are super pissed now. The websites double down, accuse everyone of being misogynist, racist harassing shitlords. They even get some of the mainstream media to go along with them. Accusations of harassment by Gamergate of women and minorities become the official story perpetuated by such news sites as The Guardian and the Huff Post to name a few.

  • Meanwhile Zoe Quinn takes her ex to court, claims harassment and gets the Judge to place a gag order on him, thus preventing him from even discussing her in public. The media portray him a abuser, he is unable to respond due to the gag order.

  • Other professional victims smell the victim dux and jump onboard claiming harassment whilst linking to their patreons. Notable examples of these are Brianna Wu, Randi Harper and Anita Sarkessien (sp?). Harassment narrative intensifies, all these people make bank and even go to the UN to have a good cry.

  • The ex bf who started the whole thing refuses to be a victim, fights Quinn in court. She vacates her restraining order against him because she was going to lose anyway. He decides to continue with his appeal in hopes to set a precedent that prevents accusations of harassment from stripping someone of their 1st Amendment Rights. This goes before the court next month. Zoe Quinn today wrote a blog post saying how terrible it is to be a woman and how she is afraid of the courts because it's a tool of the patriarchy.
